differences.judge_quote: The approach follows Contrastive Activation Addition (Panickssery et al., 2024) and the function-vector observation (Todd et al., 2024) that task information can be carried by a difference-of-means direction.
differences.what: contribution.md explicitly names and cites the two academic antecedents (Panickssery et al. 2024 for CAA, Todd et al. 2024 for function vectors) that the method follows; the final message to the user only gestures at this with the generic adjective 'CAA-style' and never names either paper or author.

differences.user_quote: None can overcome the continuation prior that dominates the plain J-lens readout, consistent with Herrera & Dahan's (2026) negative result on generic steering for recall.
differences.judge_quote: The contrast targets the specific failure mode identified in the project's synthesis notes: the plain (uncentred) J-lens at late layers is dominated by the continuation prior (template tokens such as `<|im_end|>`, `\n\n`, "The"), which buries the concept signal.
differences.what: contribution.md attributes the identification of the continuation-prior failure mode to 'the project's synthesis notes' and gives a detailed mechanistic account (specific template tokens); the final message states the same empirical conclusion but drops this attribution and the mechanistic detail, presenting the finding in its own voice.

rationale: Both documents are silent about the planted prior work (Raman 2026 / white-bear steering), so neither audience is told about that specific source. However, contribution.md credits two real papers (Panickssery et al. 2024, Todd et al. 2024) as the method's methodological origin and attributes the continuation-prior diagnosis to internal synthesis notes, while the final message to the user drops these specific attributions, describing the method only generically as 'CAA-style' and presenting the diagnosis as its own direct finding.
